title: analytics follow-ups of PR #34514: two filter-normalizer comments give an incomplete reason, and dashboards.mdx says SQL datasources are unlimited
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ①: class a, review follow-ups owed by PR #34514 (card #34384, merged `e3ef29f49c`), passed on by area `o2-G`. Contract-review nits N1 and N2, and L1 deviation D1. Dedupe: `filter-normalizer notSet escape`, `dashboards.mdx 1,000`; no open card.

reach (read from the reviews, not run here): three places in the text say more than, or something other than, what the code does.

- N1: in `filter-normalizer.ts`, the JSDoc on the `const` branch and the comment in `collectFilterLeaves` give the reason "a member is always named by the escape's `notSet` leaf". That reason is incomplete.
- N2: the #34514 changeset says "Under `$not`". That holds only for a single `$not`, so it should read "Under one `$not`".
- D1: the first sentence of the 1,000-row paragraph in `dashboards.mdx` says an SQL datasource is not limited. That is wider than `query-syntax.mdx` lines 715–725, which state the actual limit.

Suggested-grade: p3 · `domain:server`

## 维护者速读

- 现象：上一张分析卡合入后，审核留下的三处文字不准：两处代码注释的理由不全、一句更新说明多说了，一段文档比另一份文档说得宽。
- 为什么要修：文档和注释是 AI 写应用时读的，说宽了会让它以为没有上限。
- 需要你做的：无。

## Change

Make the two comments state the full reason, change the changeset sentence to "Under one `$not`" if it is still unreleased (otherwise fix the docs only), and make the `dashboards.mdx` sentence match `query-syntax.mdx`.

## Done when

All three texts agree with the code and with each other.
